targets.title: Original polynomial-time writers
targets.evidence: Kernel-verified at the original scope. For every polynomial p, machine M and input, the actual machines windowMTM p and inputMTM M p write originalWindowCode p x and originalInputCode M p x at their first halt within explicit polynomial transition bounds (windowMTM_outputs, inputMTM_outputs). Hence originalWindowCode_fp, originalInputCode_fp, the unconditional originalWM, originalWM_first_answer (T_W = 2 T_M), originalWM_decides and P_Turing_subset_P_disc_by_original. Gate scripts/verify_ii10_original_wm.sh passed on commit df8824c: Lean 4.23.0, lake build PVNP 7,386 jobs, 627 audited declarations with standard axioms only, 24 Python regression tests.
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original claim. GitHub-hosted CI has not executed for this head (issue #59); the kernel evidence is the local exact-head gate.

targets.title: Uniform separator theorem
targets.evidence: Refuted for the frozen physical trajectory class. SeparatorFrozen.no_uniform_separator_price: on the torus of side L, the exact plane-wave solutions of fixed amplitude A have curvature functional at most 4π²|A|² + 16π⁴c²|A|²/L² (any curvature operator dominated by c|Δψ|, including Δ and the Part III Θ_ε), while the Euclidean length of the frontier of the decision region {Re ψ > 0} is at least L, at every time. These fields are used by an admissible decider (stripe_device_decides); the modulus readout fails the same way (no_uniform_price_modulus). Corrected statement: layer_price (sharp width-dependent price 4η²/w).
targets.remaining_obligation: None for the original hypothesis. A uniform price needs an extra hypothesis bounding transition widths (sharp interfaces), under which SeparatorPrice.mesh_price and SeparatorFrozen.layer_price apply.
